title: Review duplicate generated source-line IDs in mesh API reference
body:
The mesh API reference published by #459 has unique API/heading anchors, but multiple expandable source blocks from GeomMeshDataclasses produce duplicate generated line IDs (for example `__span-0-60` and `__codelineno-0-60`). The local final strict build detected 52 duplicated source-line identifiers on this page; strict MkDocs validation does not flag them. The production page also passes the API/heading anchor checks.

Please review mkdocstrings/Pymdown source rendering so each source snippet gets a unique line-ID prefix without removing source visibility or breaking public API anchors. This is a renderer/navigation follow-up, not a hydraulic or API execution defect.

Acceptance criteria:
- No repeated IDs within the generated mesh reference page.
- Expandable source code, syntax highlighting and API signature rendering remain usable.
- Public method and result-class anchor URLs remain stable.
- Verify on the built HTML, not just Markdown or a successful strict build.

Page: https://rascommander.info/ras/api/rasmapper/mesh-generation/
